# bare-js evaluator cases. A case starts with `=== name`. The source runs as one sloppy script.
# The result is the completion value. `// @limit` expects an execution limit (Node: a timeout).
# Every case is a tiny independent program; Node (vm, empty context) is the oracle.
=== arith
1 + 2 * 3 - 4 / 2 % 3
=== precedence_exp
2 ** 3 ** 2
=== exp_corner
String(1 ** Infinity) + "," + String((-1) ** Infinity) + "," + String(2 ** -1) + "," + String(NaN ** 0)
=== mod_neg
String(-7 % 3) + "," + String(7 % -3) + "," + String(1 / (-1 % 1)) + "," + String(5 % 0)
=== shifts
[1 << 31, 1 << 32, -1 >>> 0, -1 >> 31, 5 >>> 1, ~5, 7 & 3, 4 | 1, 6 ^ 3].join()
=== int32_wrap
(2147483647 + 1) | 0
=== string_concat
"a" + 1 + 2 + (1 + 2) + null + undefined + true
=== add_coerce
[1 + "1", "3" - 1, "3" * "4", true + 1, null + 1, undefined + 1, [] + [], [1,2] + 3, ({}) + 1].join("|")
=== numeric_strings
[Number(""), Number(" 12 "), Number("0x1f"), Number("1e3"), Number("12px"), Number(null), Number(undefined), Number(true), Number("-0")].join()
=== to_string_numbers
[String(0.1 + 0.2), String(1e21), String(1e-7), String(123456789012345680000), String(-0), String(100), String(1.5e300), String(5e-324)].join()
=== loose_equality
[null == undefined, null == 0, "1" == 1, true == 1, "" == 0, "a" == "a", [] == "", [1] == 1, NaN == NaN, ({}) == "[object Object]"].join()
=== strict_equality
[1 === 1, "a" === "a", NaN === NaN, 0 === -0, null === undefined, ({}) === ({})].join()
=== relational
[1 < 2, "a" < "b", "10" < "9", 10 < "9", "abc" < "abd", null >= 0, undefined < 1, NaN <= NaN, [2] > 1].join()
=== typeof_all

=== void_comma
(void 0) + "," + (1, 2, 3)
=== short_circuit_and
var log = []; function t(n){ log.push(n); return n; } t(0) && t(1); t(2) && t(3); log.join()
=== short_circuit_or_nullish
var log = []; function t(n){ log.push(n); return n; } t(0) || t(1); t(5) || t(6); t(null) ?? t(7); t(8) ?? t(9); log.join()
=== logical_values
[0 || "x", 1 && "y", null ?? "z", 0 ?? "z", "" || null, 1 && 0].join()
=== logical_assign
var a = null, b = 0, c = 1; a ??= 5; b ||= 6; c &&= 7; [a, b, c].join()
=== logical_assign_short
var n = 0; var o = { get x() { n++; return 1; }, set x(v) { n += 10; } }; o.x ||= 5; o.x &&= 6; n
=== conditional

=== var_hoisting

=== function_hoisting_call

=== var_redeclare

=== tdz_let

=== let_shadow

=== block_scope

=== const_assign
